author: Ben

changes: Added 6 image filters: grayscale, brightness, contrast, invert, blur, sharpen
Added 3 transformation functions: rotate, flip, crop
Enhanced error handling with object-based patterns
Improved filter performance with optimized algorithms
Added support for complex image manipulation workflows

description: WebAssembly module for advanced image processing with filters, transformations, compression, and format conversion

errorHandling.description: Image module returns objects with 'error' field when operations fail
errorHandling.detection: if (result.error) { /* handle error */ } else { /* use result data */ }

examples.cause: Called processing function with unsupported image format
Called resizeImage() with dimensions exceeding limits
Called compression function with invalid quality value

examples.title: GoWM Integration - Basic Image Compression
Image Processing Pipeline
Error Handling Patterns

functions.description: Compress a JPEG image with specified quality level
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const result = image.call('compressJPEG', uint8ArrayData, 80);
// Returns compressed Uint8Array
functions.name: compressJPEG

parameters.description: Uint8Array of raw image bytes (JPEG, PNG, or other supported format)
parameters.name: imageData

functions.description: Compress a PNG image with optimized encoding
functions.name: compressPNG

functions.description: Optimize an image by re-encoding it as JPEG with the specified quality (note: output is JPEG, not WebP)
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const result = image.call('convertToWebP', uint8ArrayData, 85);
// Returns optimized Uint8Array (JPEG encoded)
functions.name: convertToWebP

functions.description: Resize an image to specified dimensions, preserving format (JPEG or PNG)
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const result = image.call('resizeImage', uint8ArrayData, 800, 600);
// Returns resized Uint8Array
functions.name: resizeImage

functions.description: Get metadata of an image (format, width, height, size)
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const info = image.call('getImageInfo', uint8ArrayData);
// info: { format, width, height, size }
functions.name: getImageInfo

functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const result = image.call('applyGrayscale', uint8ArrayData);
// Returns Uint8Array of grayscale image
functions.name: applyGrayscale

functions.description: Adjust the brightness of an image by a value between -100 and +100
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const result = image.call('adjustBrightness', uint8ArrayData, 30);
// Returns Uint8Array with adjusted brightness
functions.name: adjustBrightness

functions.description: Adjust the contrast of an image by a value between -100 and +100
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const result = image.call('adjustContrast', uint8ArrayData, 20);
// Returns Uint8Array with adjusted contrast
functions.name: adjustContrast

functions.description: Invert the colors of an image (negative effect)
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const result = image.call('invertColors', uint8ArrayData);
// Returns Uint8Array with inverted colors
functions.name: invertColors

functions.description: Apply a box blur to an image with a given radius (1-10)
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const result = image.call('applyBlur', uint8ArrayData, 3);
// Returns Uint8Array of blurred image
functions.name: applyBlur

functions.description: Apply a sharpen filter to an image using a 3x3 convolution kernel
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const result = image.call('applySharpen', uint8ArrayData);
// Returns Uint8Array of sharpened image
functions.name: applySharpen

functions.description: Rotate an image by 90, 180, or 270 degrees clockwise
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const result = image.call('rotateImage', uint8ArrayData, 90);
// Returns Uint8Array of rotated image
functions.name: rotateImage

parameters.description: Rotation angle in degrees, must be 90, 180, or 270
parameters.name: angle

functions.description: Flip an image horizontally or vertically
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const result = image.call('flipImage', uint8ArrayData, 'horizontal');
// Returns Uint8Array of flipped image
functions.name: flipImage

functions.description: Crop a rectangular region from an image
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const result = image.call('cropImage', uint8ArrayData, 10, 10, 200, 150);
// Returns Uint8Array of cropped region
functions.name: cropImage

parameters.description: X offset of the crop region in pixels
parameters.name: x

parameters.description: Y offset of the crop region in pixels
parameters.name: y

parameters.description: Width of the crop region in pixels
parameters.name: width

parameters.description: Height of the crop region in pixels
parameters.name: height

functions.description: Enable/disable silent mode for console logs
functions.name: setSilentMode

parameters.description: true to enable silent mode, false to disable it
parameters.name: silent

functions.description: Get list of all available functions in the module
functions.name: getAvailableFunctions

name: image-wasm

types.description: Standard result type for image operations
types.details: Returns object with processed image data on success, or object with 'error' field on failure
types.name: ImageResult

properties.format: string (image format: jpeg, png, webp, etc.)
